title: Change of date, address, email or account details
keywords: change date change address change email contact details delete account amend
body: Change of date: change on the Admin portal; update the Moveover file.
Change of address: change on the Admin portal. After agent acceptance, only with the agent's agreement.
Change of email, contact or other details: request must come by email; change on Admin; update the Access Correction file.
Delete an active account: request must come by email; send the request on the Agent / Customer deletion chat; update the Access Correction file.
